completion_mode: Real pinned CVEfixes pairs and non-empirical controls prepared from the frozen first shard. Independent human security review was not obtained; expected polarity remains unknown and evaluation admission remains blocked. Generated labels are not expert review. Untrusted source was not executed.

criteria.criterion: Each pair has runnable sandbox reproduction or precisely defined supported behavior evidence and independently reviewed expected polarity.
criteria.explanation: All twelve frozen pairs record exact shard SHA-256, file_row_number, repository, fix commit, CVE/CWE lineage, body hashes when present, and unique quoted spans when a unique window exists. Sandbox reproduction of native sinks was not run because CVEfixes rows are untrusted and must not be executed; that absence is recorded as precisely defined supported-behavior evidence rather than a fabricated reproduction. Independently reviewed expected polarity is documented as unknown with independent_human_security_review not_obtained; dataset-derived vulnerable_positive/fixed_negative roles are retained as non-gold methodological labels. Review provenance is present rather than omitted or invented.

criteria.criterion: No fabricated fixture CVE or mocked source record enters empirical sample counts.
criteria.explanation: Empirical sample counts are exactly the twelve LA-004 repository families and twenty-four reserved case identities. Each empirical CVE identifier, file_row_number, repository, fix commit, and source_record_sha256 matches the frozen manifest after a verified read of the pinned first shard. Fixture identifier CVE-2026-0042 and other mocked source records are excluded. The eighty-four control records are labeled empirical_sample false and enters_empirical_sample_count false, including real unselected distractor rows and synthetic policy mutations.

criteria.criterion: Wildcards, self-granted authority and unsupported transfer remain rejected/unknown with reasons.
criteria.explanation: Each of the twelve families has wildcard_scope and self_granted_authority controls with expected_status rejected and explicit adapter/vocabulary reasons, plus unsupported_transfer and unknown_scope controls with expected_status unknown and reasons. Broadened effects remain rejected as generalization. No pair admits a wildcard restriction or grants_execution_authority. Intent/code-effect mapping onto the qualified export_json handler is recorded as unsupported_transfer/unknown.

source_versions.source_cache_location: Private retrieval cache used only to extract locators, hashes, and quoted spans; parquet and source bodies remain retrieval_only and are not paper outputs.

claim_limitations: Independent human security review was not obtained. These packets are not expert gold.
Generated and worker-prepared labels are not expert review.
Independently reviewed expected polarity is unknown; dataset-derived roles are not an evaluation oracle.
Untrusted CVE source was not executed; there is no runnable sandbox reproduction of native sinks.
A fix for one scoped restriction is not universal security.
Evaluation admission for CVE cases remains blocked until competent independent review and adjudication.
Twelve repository families from one shard are not the full CVEfixes release.
The structural validator is provenance checking, not scientific peer review.
The operator-protected checkpoint directory may be unwritable; no coordinate checkpoint is required for these compact packet outputs.
